body:
I have had nothing but amazing experiences with Gabapentin. It is prescribed to me due to a severe nerve injury in my lower back. I begin the day with 800mg. An hour later another 1600mg and then I nibble on one-half tab (400mg) throughout the day. I have no idea how much.
The feelings I have on a daily basis are amazing - consistent, compassionate, and always very sexually aroused. I am focused to the world around me in a way that's incredible.
I love my 'gabbies'
